description: This PHP source file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy, a proprietary module for cleaning up (tidying) poorly written HTML within the HTMLPurifier library. It contains methods for managing levels of fixing, assembling fixes based on configuration, and applying transformations to HTML elements.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy
classes.description: Class for a set of proprietary modules that clean up (tidy) HTML, supporting different levels of fixes and applying transformations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the module by determining necessary fixes based on configuration and delegating to populate().

methods.name: getFixesForLevel
methods.description: Retrieves all fixes for a specified level and all levels below it.

methods.name: makeFixesForLevel
methods.description: Populates the fix levels based on provided fixes and default level setting.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Applies a set of fixes to the module by adding transformations and other modifications.

methods.name: getFixType
methods.description: Analyzes a fix name string to determine its type and parameters.

methods.name: makeFixes
methods.description: Defines the set of fixes performed by this module (empty in this implementation).
